# Patent Classification

Define your view of the technology area you operate in with** LexisNexis^{®} Classification**.

[REQUEST A MEETING][182]

Bring clarity to innovation by exploring the world of Patent Classification. Discover how the power
of machine learning can help you to gain valuable insights for your [IP strategy][183].

## **Why Classification**?

In order to effectively manage your patent portfolio, it is crucial to have a robust understanding
of the technology areas in which you operate. This knowledge allows you to analyze your competitors,
compare your performance against theirs, and optimize your portfolio accordingly.

To achieve this level of understanding, it is necessary to develop your own definition of the
technology landscape. You can utilize Classifiers to obtain a comprehensive view of this landscape
without having to manually tag patents or construct complex Boolean queries. This is an essential
tool for any IP team, as it ensures that no key patents are overlooked.

[Request a demo][184]


[[What is Patent Classification]][185]

### What is Classification

With 44M+ active patents, how can you zone in on the patents that are relevant to the technology
areas you operate in? By building a classifier that is defined to your technology area will allow
you to do this.

LexisNexis*^{®}* PatentSight+™ uses classification powered by LexisNexis® Classification, which uses
AI to read all the 44M+ patents globally and pull the relevant patents into your classifier. The
classifier is defined by you and the machine does all the hard work of going and finding the right
patents. The machine can read more than 60 million patents an hour and looks at 200,000 data points
in the [patent][186].

# Patent Classification

Define your view of the technology area you operate in with** LexisNexis^{®} Classification**.

[REQUEST A MEETING][182]

Bring clarity to innovation by exploring the world of Patent Classification. Discover how the power
of machine learning can help you to gain valuable insights for your [IP strategy][183].

## **Why Classification**?

In order to effectively manage your patent portfolio, it is crucial to have a robust understanding
of the technology areas in which you operate. This knowledge allows you to analyze your competitors,
compare your performance against theirs, and optimize your portfolio accordingly.

To achieve this level of understanding, it is necessary to develop your own definition of the
technology landscape. You can utilize Classifiers to obtain a comprehensive view of this landscape
without having to manually tag patents or construct complex Boolean queries. This is an essential
tool for any IP team, as it ensures that no key patents are overlooked.

[Request a demo][184]


[[What is Patent Classification]][185]

### What is Classification

With 44M+ active patents, how can you zone in on the patents that are relevant to the technology
areas you operate in? By building a classifier that is defined to your technology area will allow
you to do this.

LexisNexis*^{®}* PatentSight+™ uses classification powered by LexisNexis® Classification, which uses
AI to read all the 44M+ patents globally and pull the relevant patents into your classifier. The
classifier is defined by you and the machine does all the hard work of going and finding the right
patents. The machine can read more than 60 million patents an hour and looks at 200,000 data points
in the [patent][186].

## Welcome to Legalixa Law Firm

**Legalixa Law Firm** stands as a leading **Turkish Law Firm** headquartered in Istanbul, delivering
comprehensive and sophisticated legal services since 1992. With more than three decades of
experience, our firm has built a reputation for excellence, precision, and strategic insight across
a wide spectrum of legal disciplines. We serve both domestic and international clients, offering
tailored legal solutions aligned with the evolving legal and business environment in Turkey.

Our firm distinguishes itself through its multilingual capabilities, providing legal services in
**English, Chinese, French, Farsi**, and **Russian**. This linguistic diversity enables us to bridge
legal and cultural gaps effectively, ensuring seamless communication and accurate representation for
our global clientele. As a full-service Turkish Law Firm, Legalixa combines local expertise with
international standards, delivering results that meet the highest expectations.

Legalixa Law Firm was founded by **[Mr. Selcuk Akkas][78]**, who was registered before the
**[Istanbul Bar][79]** in 1992 and has practiced law continuously ever since. Over more than three
decades, the firm has built a reputation as a dependable, full-service Turkish law firm serving
individuals, families, and businesses from around the world.

## Why Choose Legalixa as Your Turkish Law Firm

Choosing the right Turkish Law Firm is critical for navigating Turkey’s legal landscape effectively.
Legalixa Law Firm offers a combination of experience, innovation, and reliability that positions us
among the top-tier firms in Istanbul.

Our team consists of highly qualified attorneys with deep expertise in their respective fields. We
continuously monitor legal developments and regulatory changes to ensure our clients receive
up-to-date and actionable advice. This proactive approach allows us to anticipate challenges and
provide solutions before issues arise.

We prioritize transparency and efficiency in all our services. Clients are kept informed at every
stage of their legal matters, ensuring clarity and confidence throughout the process. Our firm also
leverages technology to enhance service delivery, streamline communication, and maintain secure
documentation.

As a full-service Turkish law firm, Legalixa also benefits from an integrated relationship with
**[Finlexia][80]**, its affiliated accounting and financial advisory entity. This means clients can
receive coordinated legal and financial guidance under one roof, rather than having to manage
separate relationships with a lawyer and an accountant who may not communicate effectively with one
another.

## A Legacy of Trust: More Than 30 Years of Legal Practice in Istanbul

Legalixa Law Firm’s roots trace back to 1992, when its founder began practicing law in Istanbul
under the name **Akkas & Associates**. Over the following decades, the firm built a broad and
diverse practice, serving Turkish and international clients across virtually every area of civil,
commercial, and administrative law.

This long history matters because Turkish law, like any legal system, is shaped by precedent,
regulatory interpretation, and administrative practice that only becomes clear through years of
direct experience. A Turkish law firm that has operated continuously since 1992 has witnessed
multiple waves of legal reform, economic change, and shifts in foreign investment policy. That
accumulated knowledge translates directly into better outcomes for clients today.

The transition from Akkas & Associates to the Legalixa brand reflects a strategic evolution rather
than a break from the past. The same experienced legal team, the same commitment to client service,
and the same deep understanding of Turkish law remain at the core of the firm. What has changed is
the firm’s positioning as a modern, internationally focused Turkish law firm built to serve foreign
investors and global clients more directly.

[Turkish Law Firm]

Your Legal Partner in Turkey

## Proven Legal Services Under One Roof

##### Turkish Citizenship by Investment

One of the most sought-after services offered by Legalixa Law Firm is assistance with [Turkish
citizenship by investment][81]. Turkey’s citizenship by investment program has become one of the
most attractive in the world, offering a relatively fast and accessible route to a second passport
for qualifying investors and their families.

##### Company Formation and Governance

Establishing a business presence in Turkey requires careful planning and a clear understanding of
local corporate law. Legalixa Law Firm provides comprehensive [company formation][82] and governance
services designed to help foreign investors set up and manage their Turkish entities correctly from
day one.

##### Real Estate Law Services

Turkey’s real estate market has attracted significant international interest in recent years, driven
in part by the country’s Turkish citizenship by investment program and its relatively affordable
property prices compared to many other global markets. Legalixa Law Firm offers [real estate
law][83] services including buying and selling properties and managing services as well, ensuring
that foreign buyers and sellers are protected at every stage of a transaction.

What you get

## Everything in Atlas V2

A free MCPE client packed with the features that actually make mobile Minecraft better.

[Over 60 mods, one clean menu]

### Over 60 mods, one clean menu

Atlas has every module you ever needed; from visual mods, to FPS boosting tweaks, to helpful
survival utilities. Every mod is accessible and fully tweakable through the in-game mod menu.

[FPS Unlocker]

### FPS Unlocker

Breaks Minecraft's 60 FPS cap and boosts frames past your refresh rate for extra smooth input.

### Latest version support

Built for the newest Bedrock releases; currently running on 26.33.

[Make it yours]

### Make it yours

Configure almost any module to your setup. Customize colors, positions, sizes, keybinds and fonts.

### iOS Client + Version Switcher

Atlas is the first native client for iOS, with many of the same features available on Android. Atlas
Client for Bedrock iOS contains Minecraft version switcher built-in, so you can switch game versions
with the click of a button!

### No cheats, ever

Strictly quality-of-life. Atlas focuses on visual and utility mods that keep your gameplay fair.

Highlights

## Key modules

A taste of the toolkit. There are dozens more inside the menu.

### Waypoints

[Drop markers anywhere in your world]

### Quick Shortcuts

[Quick perspective, drop & hide HUD]

### Minimap

[Live overhead map on your HUD]

### Shader Loader

[Load RenderDragon material.bin shaders on ios & android]

### View Model

[Reshape the item in your hand]

### Zoom

[Zoom in anywhere with a shortcut]
Questions

## Frequently asked

Still stuck? Our community and team are active in the Discord every day.

[Ask on Discord →][16]
Is Atlas Client free?

Yes. Atlas V2 is free to download for Android on the Google Play Store, and sideloaded for iOS.
Optional Premium unlocks early access to new builds and exclusive features, like Minimap.

Will I get banned for using Atlas?

Atlas ships only non-cheat, quality-of-life modules. There are no combat or movement cheats, but as
with any third-party tool, use it at your own discretion.

Which Minecraft versions are supported?

Atlas tracks the latest Bedrock releases and currently supports version 26.33.

How do I install it on my iPhone/iPad?

Atlas for iOS is a sideloaded app. First, set up your sideloader. A common option is SideStore.
Then, launch the app and complete the initial setup.

How do I use mods/add shaders?

Everything is built in. Launch Minecraft through Atlas, open the mod menu, and toggle modules or
import MaterialBin shader resource packs.

## Ready to level up?

Download Atlas Client and bring 60+ quality-of-life mods to your next session.

Search for a company, add reports to your cart, proceed to checkout, and pay securely by credit

  ### **Executive Summary**
  
  In 2024, US patent infringement jury verdicts totaled $4.19 billion across 72 cases. Twelve
  individual verdicts exceeded $100million. The largest single award—$857 million in General Access
  Solutions v.Cellco Partnership (Verizon)—exceeded the annual R&D budget of many mid-market
  technology companies. In the first half of 2025 alone, total damages reached an additional $1.91
  billion.
  
  The consequences of incomplete patent intelligence are not abstract. In what has become one of the
  most instructive IP disputes in recent history, Masimo’s pulse oximetry patents triggered a US
  import ban on certain Apple Watch models, forcing Apple to disable its blood oxygen feature across
  an entire product line, halt domestic sales of affected models, invest in a hardware redesign, and
  ultimately face a $634 million jury verdict in November 2025. Apple—a company with one of the most
  sophisticated intellectual property organizations on earth—spent years in litigation over
  technology it might have designed around during development.
  
  For organizations with fewer resources than Apple, the risk calculus is starker. A mid-size
  materials company, a university spinout, or a defense contractor developing next-generation
  battery technology cannot absorb a nine-figure verdict or a multi-year injunction. For these
  organizations, the patent landscape analysis conducted during the development phase is the primary
  risk mitigation mechanism. The quality of that analysis is not a matter of convenience. It is a
  matter of survival.
  
  And yet, a growing number of R&D and IP teams are conducting that analysis using general-purpose
  AI tools—ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Co-Pilot—that were never designed for patent intelligence and
  are structurally incapable of delivering it.
  
  This report presents the findings of a controlled comparison study in which identical patent
  landscape queries were submitted to four AI-powered tools: Cypris (a purpose-built R&D
  intelligence platform),ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Microsoft Co-Pilot. Two
  technology domains were tested: solid-state lithium-sulfur battery electrolytes using garnet-type
  LLZO ceramic materials (freedom-to-operate analysis), and bio-based polyamide synthesis from
  castor oil derivatives (competitive intelligence).
  
  The results reveal a significant and structurally persistent gap. In Test 1, Cypris identified
  over 40 active US patents and published applications with granular FTO risk assessments. Claude
  identified 12. ChatGPT identified 7, several with fabricated attribution. Co-Pilot identified 4.
  Among the patents surfaced exclusively by Cypris were filings rated as “Very High” FTO risk that
  directly claim the technology architecture described in the query. In Test 2, Cypris cited over
  100 individual patent filings with full attribution to substantiate its competitive landscape
  rankings. No general-purpose model cited a single patent number.
  
  The most active sectors for patent enforcement—semiconductors, AI, biopharma, and advanced
  materials—are the same sectors where R&D teams are most likely to adopt AI tools for intelligence
  workflows. The findings of this report have direct implications for any organization using
  general-purpose AI to inform patent strategy, competitive intelligence, or R&D investment
  decisions.

## Finding the right key can be time consuming, costly and challenging.

For over 25 years, Harbor IP has helped clients navigate Sequence Listing compliance under WIPO
Standards ST.25 and ST.26. Put our expertise in the Intellectual Property industry to work for you
and experience the Harbor IP difference.

Counsel for meeting US (37 CFR §§1.821-.825 and 37 CFR §§1.831-.835), as well as EP, PCT, and
foreign Sequence Listing requirements under current both WIPO Standard ST.25 and WIPO Standard
ST.26.

years of experience working with various Patent Offices allows us a unique position in this
industry. Reach out and turn our experience into your advantage.

directly with our seasoned team members, you’ll have first-hand access to our deep knowledge of

We offer unmatched experience, depth of knowledge, and positive customer experience in the
Intellectual Property industry. We take the unknown out of navigating Sequence Listing preparation

is to make the difference legible — to lay out, in each category, what the established platforms do
well, where the new entrants are credible, and what to ignore.

Tool pages are written for a working reader. Each one explains what the product is actually for, the
firm sizes and practice areas it suits, where it falls short, and which alternatives are worth
considering. Pricing notes are guidance — confirm directly with the vendor before relying on them.
Where two products serve overlapping use cases, the [comparison library][20] lines them up side by
side.

  that fit.
* **You are scoping a buy.** Start with the [vendor due-diligence checklist][22], then go to the
  relevant category and compare two or three products head-to-head.

We do not publish sponsored reviews. We do not run "Top 10" lists ordered by who paid most. We do

full.

No vendor pays for placement or favourable wording.

Reviews focus on how products behave in real legal workflows.

# [prAna vs. apana…are you confused?][7]

[

**12** *Thursday* Jul 2018

][8]

Posted by [Kenan Farrell][9] in [District of Oregon][10], [Intellectual Property][11],
[Litigation][12], [Oregon][13], [Trademark][14]

**≈ [Leave a comment][15]**

**Tags**

[Common Law False Advertising][16], [Common Law Trademark Infringement][17], [Common Law Unfair
Competition][18], [False Designation of Origin][19], [Federal Trademark Infringement][20], [Federal
Unfair Competition][21], [Oregon Unfair Trade Practices Act][22], [Unfair Trade Practices][23],
[Unjust Enrichment][24], [Yoga][25], [Youlee Yim You][26]

The Plaintiff in this trademark lawsuit sells “sustainable clothing for yoga, travel, and outdoor
adventure enthusiasts” using the PRANA word mark and logo. The PRANA trademark has been used since
as early as 1992, and even this non-yogi is aware of the well-known brand.

The Defendants are accused of selling yoga apparel under the confusingly similar name “apana,”
coupled with a logo that Plaintiff feels is confusingly similar to prAna’s distinctive logo design.

Here are the trademarks…you be the judge:


Of course, we’re dealing with yoga, so the Complaint was bound to get a little weird:

“Like “prana,” “apana” is also well-known to those who practice yoga, and is closely related as the
balancing vayu to the prana-vayu. It is situated in the pelvic floor, and reflects energy that moves
downwards and outwards.” “prana and apana are opposing, yet balanced forces. Where ‘prana’ regulates
the intake of particles and energy, ‘apana’ is responsible for the elimination of the unabsorbed
residues.” Assuming regular yoga folks know all this, wouldn’t that be an argument against
confusion?

What do you think…are the trademarks confusingly similar? Sound off in the comments below and stay
tuned for updates. This one could get interesting.

Flask, an Oregon limited liability company with headquarters in Bend, Oregon, founded the HYDRO
FLASK brand and product line in 2009 and today is the North American marketer and distributor of
HYDRO FLASK-branded products. What Pacific Northwesterner doesn’t own at least one Hydro Flask for
their weekend hiking (or brewery-visiting) adventures?

Numerous defendants, some perhaps related, are accused of selling counterfeit Hydro Flask products
via counterfeit websites. Given the evidence presented in the voluminous Complaint and Exhibits (see
below), the counterfeiting seems fairly apparent. The Plaintiff has filed a subsequent Motion for
Temporary Restraining Order and Preliminary Injunction, likely the best way to deal with multiple
infringing (and non-responsive) websites.


If the counterfeiting wasn’t obvious and there was any question whether the Defendants were fighting
an uphill battle, the Plaintiff’s lead attorney, [Mrs. Benedick][43], previously served as a
Judicial Extern for the presiding judge, Michael Simon. 

The Complaint’s Exhibit List is extensive and voluminous, with Exhibit 5 perhaps taking the record
for the largest ever Exhibit logged by this blog, at a gargantuan 633 “never mind the PACER charges”
pages.

# Preliminary Injunction][28]

[

**09** *Monday* Jul 2018

][29]

Posted by [Kenan Farrell][30] in [District of Oregon][31], [Intellectual Property][32],
[Litigation][33], [Oregon][34], [Trademark][35]

**≈ [Leave a comment][36]**

**Tags**

[Federal Anti-Cybersquatting][37], [Federal False Designation of Origin][38], [Federal Trademark
Counterfeiting][39], [Federal Trademark Infringement][40], [Federal Unfair Competition][41],
[Michael H. Simon][42]

The Plaintiff in this trademark lawsuit, Helen of Troy Limited, is the owner of the immensely
popular HYDRO FLASK trademark, used in connection with vacuum insulated stainless steel water
bottles and other insulated products. Helen of Troy’s affiliate Steel Technology, LLC d/b/a Hydro
Flask, an Oregon limited liability company with headquarters in Bend, Oregon, founded the HYDRO
FLASK brand and product line in 2009 and today is the North American marketer and distributor of
HYDRO FLASK-branded products. What Pacific Northwesterner doesn’t own at least one Hydro Flask for
their weekend hiking (or brewery-visiting) adventures?

Numerous defendants, some perhaps related, are accused of selling counterfeit Hydro Flask products
via counterfeit websites. Given the evidence presented in the voluminous Complaint and Exhibits (see
below), the counterfeiting seems fairly apparent. The Plaintiff has filed a subsequent Motion for
Temporary Restraining Order and Preliminary Injunction, likely the best way to deal with multiple
infringing (and non-responsive) websites.


If the counterfeiting wasn’t obvious and there was any question whether the Defendants were fighting
an uphill battle, the Plaintiff’s lead attorney, [Mrs. Benedick][43], previously served as a
Judicial Extern for the presiding judge, Michael Simon. 

The Complaint’s Exhibit List is extensive and voluminous, with Exhibit 5 perhaps taking the record
for the largest ever Exhibit logged by this blog, at a gargantuan 633 “never mind the PACER charges”
pages.


This lawsuit will likely be a one-sided battle, with excellent high-value legal work on behalf of
the Plaintiff and probably no response from the Defendants. However, if the end result is numerous
injunctions and a (brief) stop to Hydro Flask counterfeiting, Plaintiff can be satisfied, at least
for awhile.

Stay tuned for updates.

# Welcome to Tidman Legal

## Intellectual Property Solicitors

As Intellectual Property Solicitors, Tidman Legal aims to make the process of obtaining intellectual
property rights as smooth as possible for your business. [Intellectual property][44] is an essential
part of all business. If you have ambitions to succeed in business you need to understand what your
most important asset is to properly protect and exploit it.


## BUSINESS SERVICES

## COPYRIGHT SERVICES

## TRADEMARK SERVICES

## DESIGN RIGHTS SERVICES

## PATENT SERVICES

## IP AUDIT SERVICES

###### – MORE SERVICES –

## What is Intellectual Property?

Intellectual Property (IP) is often the single most valuable asset of any business. IP is the
collective name for the rights that protect creativity, ideas and innovation. It is very wide. All
businesses have IP issues to consider because every business has a name, a logo, a website, a
database of contacts and more besides. These are all intangible assets that are important to the
success of a business. Despite this, IP is widely misunderstood and frequently unprotected and
under-exploited.

Strategic decisions about IP should be made early in the business so as to make good choices of IP
and determine how best to protect yourself with your available resources.

[Read more about Intellectual Property…][45]

[View our IP Services][46]

[tidman-icon-blue]

## How can we help you?

It is important to seek professional advice from Intellectual Property Solicitors in relation to
your IP before implementing your idea. IP law is complex, and the business, financial and legal
issues around it are difficult to navigate. By consulting an IP lawyer at an early stage you are
much better placed to make effective choices and reduce the likelihood of costly mistakes later on.

We are well placed to help you take control of your intellectual property so your business can
flourish from a secure foundation. Do get in touch for a no obligation confidential discussion and
we will tell you how we can help.

#### [More about how we can help...][47]

We offer a complimentary introductory consultation at which your business needs and options are
considered. This provides an opportunity for us to understand your business and needs, as well as to
identify ways to best protect your ideas and discuss any areas where additional protection is
required. If you already have a portfolio of IP, we also offer a regular meeting so we can discuss
developments to your products, services and business. We often act like in-house counsel to get a
real feel for your business and advise accordingly.

If you need a lawyer, we are available to help. We put ourselves at your service to meet your
business requirements and we aim to provide excellence in everything we do. We are on the phone,
e-mail and Skype. We love to chat.

## Welcome to Legalixa Law Firm

**Legalixa Law Firm** stands as a leading **Turkish Law Firm** headquartered in Istanbul, delivering
comprehensive and sophisticated legal services since 1992. With more than three decades of
experience, our firm has built a reputation for excellence, precision, and strategic insight across
a wide spectrum of legal disciplines. We serve both domestic and international clients, offering
tailored legal solutions aligned with the evolving legal and business environment in Turkey.

Our firm distinguishes itself through its multilingual capabilities, providing legal services in
**English, Chinese, French, Farsi**, and **Russian**. This linguistic diversity enables us to bridge
legal and cultural gaps effectively, ensuring seamless communication and accurate representation for
our global clientele. As a full-service Turkish Law Firm, Legalixa combines local expertise with
international standards, delivering results that meet the highest expectations.

Legalixa Law Firm was founded by **[Mr. Selcuk Akkas][78]**, who was registered before the
**[Istanbul Bar][79]** in 1992 and has practiced law continuously ever since. Over more than three
decades, the firm has built a reputation as a dependable, full-service Turkish law firm serving
individuals, families, and businesses from around the world.

[Turkish law firm]
[Istanbul, Turkey Law Firms]

## Why Choose Legalixa as Your Turkish Law Firm

Choosing the right Turkish Law Firm is critical for navigating Turkey’s legal landscape effectively.
Legalixa Law Firm offers a combination of experience, innovation, and reliability that positions us
among the top-tier firms in Istanbul.

Our team consists of highly qualified attorneys with deep expertise in their respective fields. We
continuously monitor legal developments and regulatory changes to ensure our clients receive
up-to-date and actionable advice. This proactive approach allows us to anticipate challenges and
provide solutions before issues arise.

We prioritize transparency and efficiency in all our services. Clients are kept informed at every
stage of their legal matters, ensuring clarity and confidence throughout the process. Our firm also
leverages technology to enhance service delivery, streamline communication, and maintain secure
documentation.

As a full-service Turkish law firm, Legalixa also benefits from an integrated relationship with
**[Finlexia][80]**, its affiliated accounting and financial advisory entity. This means clients can
receive coordinated legal and financial guidance under one roof, rather than having to manage
separate relationships with a lawyer and an accountant who may not communicate effectively with one
another.

## A Legacy of Trust: More Than 30 Years of Legal Practice in Istanbul

Legalixa Law Firm’s roots trace back to 1992, when its founder began practicing law in Istanbul
under the name **Akkas & Associates**. Over the following decades, the firm built a broad and
diverse practice, serving Turkish and international clients across virtually every area of civil,
commercial, and administrative law.

This long history matters because Turkish law, like any legal system, is shaped by precedent,
regulatory interpretation, and administrative practice that only becomes clear through years of
direct experience. A Turkish law firm that has operated continuously since 1992 has witnessed
multiple waves of legal reform, economic change, and shifts in foreign investment policy. That
accumulated knowledge translates directly into better outcomes for clients today.

The transition from Akkas & Associates to the Legalixa brand reflects a strategic evolution rather
than a break from the past. The same experienced legal team, the same commitment to client service,
and the same deep understanding of Turkish law remain at the core of the firm. What has changed is
the firm’s positioning as a modern, internationally focused Turkish law firm built to serve foreign
investors and global clients more directly.

[Turkish Law Firm]

Your Legal Partner in Turkey

## Proven Legal Services Under One Roof

##### Turkish Citizenship by Investment

One of the most sought-after services offered by Legalixa Law Firm is assistance with [Turkish
citizenship by investment][81]. Turkey’s citizenship by investment program has become one of the
most attractive in the world, offering a relatively fast and accessible route to a second passport
for qualifying investors and their families.

##### Company Formation and Governance

Establishing a business presence in Turkey requires careful planning and a clear understanding of
local corporate law. Legalixa Law Firm provides comprehensive [company formation][82] and governance
services designed to help foreign investors set up and manage their Turkish entities correctly from
day one.

##### Real Estate Law Services

Turkey’s real estate market has attracted significant international interest in recent years, driven
in part by the country’s Turkish citizenship by investment program and its relatively affordable
property prices compared to many other global markets. Legalixa Law Firm offers [real estate
law][83] services including buying and selling properties and managing services as well, ensuring
that foreign buyers and sellers are protected at every stage of a transaction.

Everything is built in. Launch Minecraft through Atlas, open the mod menu, and toggle modules or

## in Tajikistan

Our firm is a full service intellectual property practice based in Tajikistan. We advise and
represent businesses, inventors, universities, and international companies on the protection,
management, and enforcement of intellectual property rights.

Our attorneys and patent agents are officially registered and authorized to act before the national
intellectual property authorities. We combine in depth knowledge of local legislation with
international IP standards to ensure effective and reliable protection of our clients’ innovations
and brands.

## Intellectual Property Services in Tajikistan

Full-service patent and trademark attorneys representing local and international clients before the
intellectual property authorities of the Republic of Tajikistan.

### PATENTS

We provide full patent services in Tajikistan, including:
* Patent searches and patentability assessments
* Drafting and filing patent applications
* Prosecution before the patent office
* PCT national phase entry in Tajikistan
* Patent maintenance and renewals

### TRADEMARKS

Our trademark services include:
* Trademark searches and clearance
* Filing and registration
* Opposition and cancellation proceedings
* Recordal of assignments and licenses
* Trademark renewals

### INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS

We assist clients with:
* Design searches
* Filing and registration of industrial designs
* Renewal of registered industrial designs

### COPYRIGHT

We advise on copyright protection for:
* Literary and artistic works
* Software and databases
* Licensing and assignments

### IP STRATEGY & ENFORCEMENT

Our IP Strategy & Enforcement services include:
* IP portfolio management
* Infringement analysis, legal opinions and risk assessments
* Enforcement actions

  ### **Executive Summary**
  
  In 2024, US patent infringement jury verdicts totaled $4.19 billion across 72 cases. Twelve
  individual verdicts exceeded $100million. The largest single award—$857 million in General Access
  Solutions v.Cellco Partnership (Verizon)—exceeded the annual R&D budget of many mid-market
  technology companies. In the first half of 2025 alone, total damages reached an additional $1.91
  billion.
  
  The consequences of incomplete patent intelligence are not abstract. In what has become one of the
  most instructive IP disputes in recent history, Masimo’s pulse oximetry patents triggered a US
  import ban on certain Apple Watch models, forcing Apple to disable its blood oxygen feature across
  an entire product line, halt domestic sales of affected models, invest in a hardware redesign, and
  ultimately face a $634 million jury verdict in November 2025. Apple—a company with one of the most
  sophisticated intellectual property organizations on earth—spent years in litigation over
  technology it might have designed around during development.
  
  For organizations with fewer resources than Apple, the risk calculus is starker. A mid-size
  materials company, a university spinout, or a defense contractor developing next-generation
  battery technology cannot absorb a nine-figure verdict or a multi-year injunction. For these
  organizations, the patent landscape analysis conducted during the development phase is the primary
  risk mitigation mechanism. The quality of that analysis is not a matter of convenience. It is a
  matter of survival.
  
  And yet, a growing number of R&D and IP teams are conducting that analysis using general-purpose
  AI tools—ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Co-Pilot—that were never designed for patent intelligence and
  are structurally incapable of delivering it.
  
  This report presents the findings of a controlled comparison study in which identical patent
  landscape queries were submitted to four AI-powered tools: Cypris (a purpose-built R&D
  intelligence platform),ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Microsoft Co-Pilot. Two
  technology domains were tested: solid-state lithium-sulfur battery electrolytes using garnet-type
  LLZO ceramic materials (freedom-to-operate analysis), and bio-based polyamide synthesis from
  castor oil derivatives (competitive intelligence).

  over 40 active US patents and published applications with granular FTO risk assessments. Claude
  identified 12. ChatGPT identified 7, several with fabricated attribution. Co-Pilot identified 4.

  rankings. No general-purpose model cited a single patent number.

The Plaintiff in this trademark lawsuit sells “sustainable clothing for yoga, travel, and outdoor
adventure enthusiasts” using the PRANA word mark and logo. The PRANA trademark has been used since
as early as 1992, and even this non-yogi is aware of the well-known brand.

The Defendants are accused of selling yoga apparel under the confusingly similar name “apana,”
coupled with a logo that Plaintiff feels is confusingly similar to prAna’s distinctive logo design.

Here are the trademarks…you be the judge:


Of course, we’re dealing with yoga, so the Complaint was bound to get a little weird:

“Like “prana,” “apana” is also well-known to those who practice yoga, and is closely related as the
balancing vayu to the prana-vayu. It is situated in the pelvic floor, and reflects energy that moves
downwards and outwards.” “prana and apana are opposing, yet balanced forces. Where ‘prana’ regulates
the intake of particles and energy, ‘apana’ is responsible for the elimination of the unabsorbed
residues.” Assuming regular yoga folks know all this, wouldn’t that be an argument against
confusion?

What do you think…are the trademarks confusingly similar? Sound off in the comments below and stay
tuned for updates. This one could get interesting.

products, thoughtful execution, and real support

# Welcome to Tidman Legal

## Intellectual Property Solicitors

As Intellectual Property Solicitors, Tidman Legal aims to make the process of obtaining intellectual
property rights as smooth as possible for your business. [Intellectual property][44] is an essential
part of all business. If you have ambitions to succeed in business you need to understand what your
most important asset is to properly protect and exploit it.


## BUSINESS SERVICES

## COPYRIGHT SERVICES

## TRADEMARK SERVICES

## DESIGN RIGHTS SERVICES

## PATENT SERVICES

## IP AUDIT SERVICES

###### – MORE SERVICES –

## What is Intellectual Property?

Intellectual Property (IP) is often the single most valuable asset of any business. IP is the
collective name for the rights that protect creativity, ideas and innovation. It is very wide. All
businesses have IP issues to consider because every business has a name, a logo, a website, a
database of contacts and more besides. These are all intangible assets that are important to the
success of a business. Despite this, IP is widely misunderstood and frequently unprotected and
under-exploited.

Strategic decisions about IP should be made early in the business so as to make good choices of IP
and determine how best to protect yourself with your available resources.

[Read more about Intellectual Property…][45]

[View our IP Services][46]

[tidman-icon-blue]

## How can we help you?

It is important to seek professional advice from Intellectual Property Solicitors in relation to
your IP before implementing your idea. IP law is complex, and the business, financial and legal
issues around it are difficult to navigate. By consulting an IP lawyer at an early stage you are
much better placed to make effective choices and reduce the likelihood of costly mistakes later on.

We are well placed to help you take control of your intellectual property so your business can
flourish from a secure foundation. Do get in touch for a no obligation confidential discussion and
we will tell you how we can help.

#### [More about how we can help...][47]

We offer a complimentary introductory consultation at which your business needs and options are
considered. This provides an opportunity for us to understand your business and needs, as well as to
identify ways to best protect your ideas and discuss any areas where additional protection is
required. If you already have a portfolio of IP, we also offer a regular meeting so we can discuss
developments to your products, services and business. We often act like in-house counsel to get a
real feel for your business and advise accordingly.

If you need a lawyer, we are available to help. We put ourselves at your service to meet your
business requirements and we aim to provide excellence in everything we do. We are on the phone,
e-mail and Skype. We love to chat.

[Arrange a meeting][48]

[keyboard]

## Startup Packages

Tidman Legal offers a range of fixed price start-up packages based on your particular business
situation and requirements. From securing vital intellectual property protection to ensuring your
business is legally prepared to go online, we have a suitable package for you.
